reason: I have never seen Turbolux on TV, so I don't know if the paint is any good, and a 'certified crew' still sounds like a subcontractor to me. For my flat I'd rather call the big paint company I already know and pay a bit more.
objection: Once the crew has left and something bubbles a year later, will this small Kerala company still be around and still pick up the phone, or will the coordinator just stop answering?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a Turbolux job in my own building or a neighbour's flat in Kakkanad that still looks good after a monsoon, with the owner telling me the coordinator actually answered when there was a problem.
